summary: The core security hardening of httpProxy.ts is well-implemented: binds to concrete loopback, rejects malformed requests with 400, uses raw header validation, handles IPv6 URI serialization, and preserves port-0 fallback. All 364 tests pass and build succeeds. However, two test files from task 3 have lint errors (import sorting and prettier formatting) that need to be fixed for code quality consistency.

findings.description: test/InvocationModel.test.ts has 3 eslint errors: import sort order (line 4), prettier multiline formatting (line 36), and trailing comma (line 123). test/ProgrammingModel.test.ts has 1 eslint error: import sort order (line 4), plus 2 non-null assertion warnings (lines 57, 117). All errors are auto-fixable with `npx eslint --fix`.

fixTasks.title: Fix lint errors in test files
fixTasks.description:
Run `npx eslint test/InvocationModel.test.ts test/ProgrammingModel.test.ts --fix` to auto-fix 4 lint errors:
1. test/InvocationModel.test.ts line 4: import sort order (simple-import-sort/imports)
2. test/InvocationModel.test.ts line 36: prettier multiline formatting of sinon.stub chain
3. test/InvocationModel.test.ts line 123: trailing comma in type assertion
4. test/ProgrammingModel.test.ts line 4: import sort order (simple-import-sort/imports)

After auto-fix, verify with `npx eslint test/InvocationModel.test.ts test/ProgrammingModel.test.ts` (should report 0 errors, only the 2 existing non-null assertion warnings in ProgrammingModel.test.ts are acceptable). Then run `npm test` to confirm all tests still pass.
